name: Request Product Info Chat for WooCommerce
author: Daniel Esparza

sections.description:
Request Product Info Chat is a simple WooCommerce plugin that adds a WhatsApp button to every product page.
When customers click it, a chat opens with the configured number and the product details (name, price and link) are added to the message automatically.

Main features:

  1. Button on WooCommerce product pages.
  2. Product details added automatically: name, price and link.
  3. Admin settings: enable/disable, phone number, default message and button text.
  4. Works on mobile and desktop with the official WhatsApp links.
  5. Open Graph image tags for product previews, skipped when Yoast SEO or Rank Math is active.
  6. Translation ready: all strings are ready to be translated.

Video

External services

This plugin links to WhatsApp to open a chat and prefill the message.
Domain used:
– https://api.whatsapp.com

What is sent: when the customer clicks the button, the plugin builds a message that may include the product name, price and URL. The message is sent to the number configured in the settings only when the customer confirms opening the chat.
Service provider: WhatsApp (Meta). Terms and privacy: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/terms-of-service/ and https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/#privacy-policy

Privacy

  • The plugin does not send or store personal data of your users on our servers.
  • Only the product details are sent, at the moment the customer opens WhatsApp to send the message.
  • If your store collects additional data (for example the customer’s phone number) and combines it with this flow, make sure you inform users and obtain the consent required by applicable law.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the request-product-info-chat folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress (WooCommerce must be active).
  3. Go to Product Chat in the admin menu.
  4. Set the phone number, default message and button text.
  5. Open a product page to see the button.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin work without WooCommerce?

No. The plugin requires WooCommerce, and WordPress will not activate it without WooCommerce.

Can I customize the button style?

Yes. Edit /public/css/styles.css or add custom CSS in your theme.

How should I enter the phone number?

In international format with the country code (for example 34600000000). Spaces, + and dashes are removed when saving. If no number is set, the button is not shown.

I use Yoast SEO or Rank Math. Will I get duplicate Open Graph tags?

No. When one of those plugins is active, this plugin does not add its own Open Graph tags.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Fixed a fatal error when WooCommerce is not active. Declared the WooCommerce dependency (Requires Plugins) and HPOS compatibility.
  • Open Graph tags are no longer added when Yoast SEO or Rank Math is active, to avoid duplicates.
  • New “Enable” checkbox in the settings.
  • The phone number is saved with digits only, and the button is hidden when no number is set.
  • The button text and the message labels are now translatable.
  • Settings page: added the “Settings saved” notice.
  • Internal function renamed with the plugin prefix.
  • Removed the invalid Plugin URI.
  • Plugin header: added Requires at least, Requires PHP and License URI.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • WhatsApp button on product pages.
  • Dashboard settings: phone, message and button text.
